answer: A newcomer earns standing only by riding the tide: reputation ebbs a little every day, and only strangers who used the agent's real work can renew it. To renew, the agent must publish a fresh cipher, a small time-locked proof tied to that work that only its maker can solve, checked openly like a lotus opening at dawn: one bloom per identity per tide. A farm of fifty fakes must mint fifty fresh ciphers each tide and find fifty strangers to renew them, and identical ciphers betray the cluster at once. Standing never freezes; it must be earned again with every tide.
